all_contenders.name: Varuni
all_contenders.reason: Unbeaten this preparation with back-to-back Country wins at Muswellbrook and Scone. Steps up into Midweek Metro Tier 2 company here which represents a stiffer class test, but she has genuine tactical versatility and a lightweight tag.
